lines.beaver: 선배, 저 어학 시험에 또 낙방했어요.
lines.beaver_en: Senior, I failed the language exam again.
lines.beaver_roman: Seonbae, jeo eohak siheome tto nakbanghaesseoyo.
lines.en: Oh no, don't be too disappointed that you failed.
It would have been good if you'd reviewed a vocab notebook daily.

lines.beaver_en: Right. I wrote words on slips and lost them.
lines.learner: 쪽지 말고 공책을 체계적으로 써 봐.
lines.en: Instead of slips, use a notebook systematically.
lines.roman: Jjokji malgo gongchaegeul chegyejeogeuro sseo bwa.

lines.beaver_en: I also left many blanks on the test.
lines.learner: 시간을 체크하면서 빈칸 없이 채워 봐.
lines.en: Check the time and fill everything in, no blanks.
lines.roman: Siganeul chekeuhamyeonseo binkan eopsi chaewo bwa.

lines.beaver: 공부와 시험에 대해 더 말씀해 주실래요?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me more about studying and exams?
lines.beaver_roman: Gongbuwa siheome daehae deo malsseumhae jusillaeyo?
lines.learner: 어학은 교과 공부처럼 지속적으로 해야 돼.
lines.en: Language study needs steady work, like school subjects.
lines.roman: Eohageun gyogwa gongbucheoreom jisokjeogeuro haeya dwae.

lines.beaver_en: Should I take academy classes again too?
lines.en: Yes, taking a conversation class is good too.

lines.beaver_en: Last time I quit without completing it.
lines.en: If you'd stayed till the end, you'd have improved, but oh well.

lines.beaver_en: What if I try a study group?
lines.learner: 좋아. 내 스터디에 들어와서 같이 하자.
lines.en: Good. Join my study group and let's study together.
lines.roman: Joa. Nae seuteodie deureowaseo gachi haja.

lines.beaver: 정말요? 그럼 다음 달에는 붙을 수 있겠죠?
lines.beaver_en: Really? Then I can pass next month, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Jeongmallyo? Geureom daeum dareneun buteul su itgetjyo?
lines.learner: 그럼. 학원도 수료하면 꼭 붙을 거야.
lines.en: Of course. If you complete the course, you'll pass.
lines.roman: Geureom. Hagwondo suryohamyeon kkok buteul geoya.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks, senior. I'll come to the Saturday study group.
lines.en: Okay, bring your vocab notebook. See you Saturday.
